notes: ACCESS: robots.txt allows category browsing (no Claude-bot mention, /filters/ and a few paths disallowed for User-agent:* but that does not block tier c per project rule). Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (requests, browser UA) returned HTTP 429 PerimeterX px-captcha wall on the homepage - blocked. Tier (b) Playwright headless AND headed with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled both hit the same PerimeterX px-captcha wall - blocked. Escalated to tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome (logged-in real Chrome session), which loaded the site normally - used for the full research pass. TREE: built via mega-menu hover (read_page/find on each top-nav dropdown: FURNITURE, DECOR, OUTDOOR, RUGS, BEDDING, BATH, KITCHEN, DINING) plus each 'cat' page's own sub-nav tiles (Bath Linens & Accessories, Kitchen Organization & Accessories > Countertop Organization, Fabric By the Yard). QTY: rendered category-page header 'Category Name  N Items' (breadcrumb h1 + item-count element located via find tool), confirmed the h1 matched the requested node on every leaf visited; NOT the Constructor.io structured count per prior project guidance. Area Rugs page displays a capped 'Over 50,000 Items' (not an exact number) so qty=null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag instead of guessing. EXCLUDED: Furniture > Storage Furniture (Cabinets & Chests, Storage Benches) and Home Office > Filing Cabinets - explicitly placed under the FURNITURE mega-menu, already owned by Furniture.xlsx (storage.md Sec21). Decorative Trays and Wall Shelves (Decor menu) - decorative/wall-decor per storage.md Sec18/Sec23-24, not storage. Napkin Holders & Paper Towel Holders (Kitchen) - dispenser, not containment/storage. Countertop Accessories (Bath) and Napkin Rings & Table Markers / Floral Arrangements & Centerpieces / Vases (Dining) - decorative/serveware, not textile or storage. Rug Pads and the six size-filtered Area Rugs slices (12x15, 10x14, 9x12, 8x10, 7x9, 5x8) and Rug Samples - accessory/duplicate-of-Area-Rugs facets, not distinct product categories, skipped to avoid inflating/duplicating the Area Rugs record. No Kitchen textiles (tea towels/aprons/oven mitts) exist anywhere in the nav - site does not carry them. Outdoor Rugs appears identically in both the RUGS and OUTDOOR mega-menus (same URL/count) - recorded once under the Rugs group only, per duplicate-URL rule. Kitchen: Canisters & Jars, Utensil Crocks & Spoon Rests, Pot Racks (children of Countertop Organization) and Bath: Medicine Cabinets and Decor: Decorative Baskets & Bins / Desktop Organizers & Desk Pads are LOW/MEDIUM-confidence storage calls (mixed decorative/organizing character or bundled sub-name) - see per-row flags.
